description: Static public deployment directory. Source-pinned records; no live chain status is asserted.

suites.name: AGI Alpha Agent
suites.sourceNote: The archived Solidity 0.8.24 deployment sources identify these instances. Later source changes do not alter the deployed contracts.

contracts.name: AscensionAccess
contracts.role: Checks ENS identity and participant admission.

contracts.name: NovaSeed
contracts.role: Records ownership of the token representing a committed plan and its lineage.

contracts.name: AscensionRiskOracle
contracts.role: Coordinates staked risk review and reviewer availability.

contracts.name: AscensionJobMarket
contracts.role: Runs auctions, work review and settlement for the Alpha market.

contracts.name: AscensionMark
contracts.role: Restricts funding to the committed work plan in its fixed Alpha market.

suites.name: AGI Jobs
suites.sourceNote: Deployed source: source-v2.1.0-rc.4, commit b4c5b66ea05a6bb27f1f1cb197f055c179bbd38e. Newer documentation or release tags do not redeploy these instances.

contracts.name: Deployer
contracts.role: Assembles the deployment and coordinates its initial configuration.

contracts.name: StakeManager
contracts.role: Holds participant stakes and job funds under the protocol rules.

contracts.name: JobRegistry
contracts.role: Records assignments, deadlines, submitted work and job outcomes.

contracts.name: ValidationModule
contracts.role: Coordinates validator selection and commit/reveal review rounds.

contracts.name: ReputationEngine
contracts.role: Records the reputation effects of work and review outcomes.

contracts.name: ArbitratorCommittee
contracts.role: Coordinates committee decisions for escalated disputes.

contracts.name: DisputeModule
contracts.role: Tracks challenges to job outcomes and their resolution.

contracts.name: CertificateNFT
contracts.role: Issues transferable certificates for completed work under its rules.

contracts.name: FeePool
contracts.role: Collects and distributes protocol fees under its configuration.

contracts.name: IdentityRegistry
contracts.role: Checks participant identity and the names or aliases admitted by governance.

contracts.name: PlatformRegistry
contracts.role: Registers participating platforms and their protocol standing.

contracts.name: JobRouter
contracts.role: Routes work through the configured platform relationships.

contracts.name: PlatformIncentives
contracts.role: Coordinates configured platform participation incentives.

contracts.name: SystemPause
contracts.role: Provides coordinated pause controls for managed protocol components.

contracts.name: JobRegistryConfiguration
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of job configuration and administrative logic.

contracts.name: JobRegistryLifecycle
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of job creation, application and submission logic.

contracts.name: JobRegistrySettlement
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of job finalization and settlement logic.

contracts.name: StakeManagerConfiguration
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of stake and economic parameter configuration.

contracts.name: StakeManagerStaking
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of participant stake operations.

contracts.name: StakeManagerEscrow
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of job funding, escrow and payout operations.

contracts.name: StakeManagerSlashing
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of penalties and related stake accounting.

contracts.name: ValidationModuleConfiguration
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of review parameters and administrative logic.

contracts.name: ValidationModuleVoting
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of commit/reveal voting and review completion.

contracts.name: ValidationModuleSelection
contracts.role: Fixed implementation of validator selection logic.
